# MBMR Auto — AI Agent Context & Knowledge Base

## Product Categories & Specialties
1. **Alternators & Starters (Specialty)**: High-output alternators, starter motors, LIN-bus voltage regulators, decoupler pulleys, heavy-duty 24V commercial starters.
2. **Brakes & Friction**: Ceramic and semi-metallic brake pads, rust-inhibiting coated rotors, brake calipers, master cylinders, brake hoses, and ABS sensors.
3. **Suspension & Steering**: Complete quick-strut assemblies, shock absorbers, control arms with pre-pressed ball joints, tie rod ends, sway bar links, and steering racks.
4. **Air Conditioning & Climate**: Brand-new AC compressors, condensers, evaporators, expansion valves, and heater blower motors.
5. **Wholesale Tires**: All-season, winter, all-weather, and commercial light truck tires for repair shops and passenger vehicles.
6. **Commercial & Heavy Truck Parts**: 24V electrical components, air brake chambers, heavy-duty drums, leaf springs, and fleet maintenance parts.
7. **Body & Collision Parts**: OEM-fitment bumper covers, fenders, hoods, grilles, quarter panels, side mirrors, and crash support bars.
8. **Engines & Powertrain**: Tested replacement engines, cylinder heads, timing chain kits, water pumps, oil pumps, and CV axles.
9. **Automotive Lighting**: DOT/SAE compliant LED headlights, HID ballast kits, tail lamps, fog lights, and turn signals.
